text: 【前纽约联储首席：美国10月CPI将小幅降温 12月加息后会“歇一段时间”！】北京时间今晚，美国劳工统计局将公布美国10月消费者价格指数（CPI）。分析指出，10月CPI可能会显示价格压力有所缓解，符合经济学家的预期。但根据法国外贸银行美国首席经济学家Christopher Hodge的说法，虽然几乎没有证据表明美国通胀正在重新加速，但回到美联储目标的道路看起来并不平坦，12月再次加息后会“歇一段时间”。
text_en: [Former New York Fed chief: U.S. October CPI to cool slightly; after a December hike, the Fed will "take a break for a while"!] Beijing time tonight, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the U.S. October Consumer Price Index (CPI). Analysts noted that October CPI may show some easing in price pressures, in line with economists' expectations. But according to Christopher Hodge, chief U.S. economist at Natixis, while there is little evidence that U.S. inflation is re-accelerating, the path back to the Fed's target does not look smooth, and after another rate hike in December the Fed will "take a break for a while."
